name: softube-tape-parallel-thick
description: Parallel tape thickener for drums/bass via Softube Tape — the Chiccarelli/Willing move. Type C (most saturated/colored) driven HARD (Amount 8) but blended to 50% DRY/WET so the dry transients survive while the wet adds harmonic weight/grit. Measured: full-wet Amount 8 = -0.93 dB crest; at 50% blend = -0.63 dB (punch preserved).
intended_for: drums or bass that want fatness + grit without losing attack. Parallel insert on the stem/bus.
plugin_build: Softube 'Tape.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok/PACE — authorized on this rig, re-verify elsewhere). String-enum params → this harness only.
notes: dry_wet '50.0' is the internal parallel blend (DRY=0 .. WET=100). Drive Amount hard (8-10) THEN pull the blend back — the plugin's own dry path keeps the transients.
For BASS use Type B (transformer weight) at 15 IPS, ~50/50, to add midrange harmonics while keeping sub tight. For dirtier drums push Amount toward 10 (watch for 2-5 kHz spit).
Verify the blend kept crest up vs full-wet (measure-loudness), and that it added LF/harmonics not just level (measure-spectrum), render-ab loudness-matched.
